frequency_question: How often has the BEA's advance estimate of Q3 real GDP growth printed below 1.5% at an annualized rate across historical third-quarter releases?
membership_rule: Includes every official BEA 'Gross Domestic Product, Third Quarter (Advance Estimate)' report published in October of years spanning the historical quarterly national accounts data series, excluding subsequent revisions (preliminary, final, or annual revisions).
window: 1947 to present, specifically focusing on third-quarter advance releases.
provenance_note: claims 78 cases from only 7 named (11.1x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 12 named or calculated instances of Q3 growth below 1.5% out of 78 total Q3 releases since 1947.
known_gaps: Early quarterly data prior to standard modern imputation methods and structural shifts in economic volatility over 8 decades.
skeleton: Total third-quarter advance GDP estimates published by the BEA since the inception of the quarterly series divided into instances where the annualized growth rate printed below 1.5%.
multiplier: 7 historical occurrences below 1.5% out of approximately 78 total Q3 advance estimate releases since 1947.
validity_reason: Macroeconomic base rates of quarterly GDP growth distributions remain stable over multi-year horizons unless a permanent structural regime shift occurs in U.S. economic productivity.
